lede: SMU carries a full EdgeDesk team rating at +8.5; UC Davis is not one of the 138 FBS programmes EdgeDesk rates, so the comparison is one-sided by construction rather than by judgement.
EdgeDesk makes it SMU -40.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with SMU winning 100% of simulations.

The roster and position-group comparison below explains where EdgeDesk’s separation comes from on the side it can measure; UC Davis is absent from the FBS player dataset, so the exact size of that gap is not established.
Data confidence on this matchup is 11% — low enough that the exact margin should be read as provisional rather than as a settled number.

advantages.note: An advantage is only claimed where BOTH teams carry a national rank in that category — the national rank is the one scale on which a QB room and a run defence are comparable. A category where one side is unrated appears here as a measurement and as uncertainty, never as an edge.

favourite.heading: Why SMU can pull away
bullets: SMU is the better football team by 35.9 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 86% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+35.9 pts).
Playing at SMU is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).

underdog.heading: Why UC Davis can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 +16.0 to p90 +61.0 for SMU, so a projection of +40.0 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
70% of the model’s own input contract was empty for this game — no starter, injury, schedule or per-player talent context reached it, so the number leans on team strength more than it should.
UC Davis is not in the FBS rating set, so EdgeDesk cannot measure what it does well. An unmeasured opponent is an unknown, not a weak one, and the size of the gap is not established.
